notes.title: Billiards of the Round Table is now fully released!
notes.content:
Hello all!

We are very happy and excited to announce that Billiards of the Round Table is now out of Early Access and into Full Release. We hope you will enjoy our game as much as we enjoyed making it.

We wish to express our utmost gratitude to everybody who joined during our Early Access stage and provided us with invaluable feedback. Thank you!

The whole Moustache Cabal team wishes everybody in the Steam community lots of fun playing Billiards of the Round Table!

Enjoy!

Moustache Cabal
